description: This Java class defines an immutable data object EntityDataTableChecksData related to entity data table checks within the Fineract project. It contains fields such as id, entity, status, datatableName, systemDefined, order, productId, and productName, with a constructor to initialize these fields.

classes.name: EntityDataTableChecksData
classes.description: Immutable data object for entity data table checks, implementing Serializable, containing fields to represent check data related to entities in the data query infrastructure.
